tagline: Ramona Fresh Fruits carries on a family legacy – San Diego Union
description: In Riverside, CA, Fruits typically grown: raises Apples, Peaches, Pomegranates, Oranges, and Lemons on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn, summer, and winter. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
